title: Servanthood of Christ
definition: The servanthood of Christ is His humble mission to obey the Father, serve the needy, and give His life as a ransom for many.
summary: Jesus came not to be served but to serve.
christFocus: Christ's servant-hearted love is displayed supremely in His cross and becomes the pattern for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus is Lord, yet He came as servant. His servanthood does not deny His authority; it reveals how divine love moves toward sinners in humility.

He washed feet, welcomed the lowly, touched the unclean, taught the confused, and gave His life for the guilty.

The servanthood of Christ becomes the pattern for Christian leadership and discipleship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Pride seeks status and control, but Christ reveals greatness through service. This doctrine matters because the Lord of glory stooped to save.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Serve others without demanding recognition. Let the humility of Christ reshape your view of greatness, leadership, and ministry.
